DS-Albireo.title: Albireo · telescope photograph
DS-Albireo.note: A telescope exposure shows the two colored components. This is not a handheld binocular simulation. The source image is displayed without editing.

DS-MizarAlcor.title: Mizar & Alcor · telescope photograph
DS-MizarAlcor.credit: Thomas Bresson; source scaled by Antonsusi · Wikimedia Commons
DS-MizarAlcor.note: The telescope photograph resolves Mizar’s close binary as well as the wide Alcor companion. Ordinary binoculars reveal the wide pair. StarHop displays the source image without further editing.

STAR-Betelgeuse.title: Betelgeuse · ALMA stellar disk
STAR-Betelgeuse.credit: ALMA (ESO/NAOJ/NRAO) / E. O’Gorman / P. Kervella · Wikimedia Commons
STAR-Betelgeuse.note: A false-color submillimeter image resolves the star’s disk. Binoculars show a point of light; they cannot resolve this surface. The source image is displayed without editing.

STAR-Sirius.title: Sirius A & B · Hubble close-up
STAR-Sirius.credit: NASA / ESA / H. Bond (STScI) / M. Barstow (University of Leicester)
STAR-Sirius.note: Hubble’s exposure overexposes Sirius A to reveal faint Sirius B. The companion is not a binocular target. The source image is displayed without editing.
